title: AR51005: Advanced Theory Of Arch. And Research Methodology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definition, Scope and Importance of Architectural Research; The process of
research â developing concepts, formulating hypotheses and empirical testing;
Research strategy â Approaches (Diagnostic, descriptive, theoretical and
action), Designs (Case study, Survey, Experiment) and Settings (Natural,
Contrived); Substance and context of research â professional and academic;
Analogical, deductive and inductive reasoning; Analytical and synthetic
processes in design and practice.Assessing the performance of built environment
â aesthetic, functional, social and economic; Perceptions, attitudes and values
of the observer; Complexity, scale and level of analysis. New areas of
research: Style and creativity in research process, architectural
communication, value engineering and building economics research, culture and
content, mathematics, science and art in architecture, evaluation research â
alternative generation and optimization techniques.
